statement: People struggle to keep track of disparate due dates across various utilities, service providers, and credit cards, leading to late payment anxiety and fees.
normalized_problem: Difficulty tracking multiple bill due dates and payment timelines
desired_outcome: Maintain a single consolidated calendar or checklist showing exact bill due dates and amounts.
current_solutions: Bill organizer apps (e.g., Chronicle, Bills Organizer & Reminder)
attempts: Sorting paper mail into inbox trays
Using fillable PDF trackers or spreadsheet schedules
solution_complaints: Complex financial software requires too much manual setup and daily management
